data.file_warnings: *** AXIS DECISION REVERSED 2026-07-25 -- BREAK LINE, NOT AN EXPANSION JOINT *** An earlier pass on this house read the double vertical line between grids ⑧ and ⑩ on S-01/S-02/S-03 as a structural expansion joint, concluded that grid ⑨ did not exist, and adopted a 10-line / 9-bay grid. THAT WAS WRONG. Re-examined at 4.5x magnification, the double line carries the standard ZIGZAG BREAK SYMBOL at mid-height: it is a drawing interruption, used on the 1:100 sheets to omit the repeating middle bays so the 36 m building fits the paper. Grid ⑨ is hidden inside the break, which is exactly why ⑧ and ⑩ appear adjacent and why 7→8 and 10→11 both still measure 3.60 m. E-02 (หน้า23, แปลนไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง, 1:125) and A-03 (หน้า04, ผังบริเวณ, 1:125) are drawn at a smaller scale, fit the whole building without a break, and BOTH print the full axis 1..11 at a uniform 3.60 m with grid ⑨ present and ten ห้องนอน. THE CORRECT GRID IS 1..11, UNIFORM 3.60 m, 10 BAYS, 36.00 m OVERALL. Every sheet is consistent with this once the break is understood; nothing in the set actually conflicts. Consequence for this folder: element lists extracted from the 1:100 sheets record what is DRAWN (10 column lines), not the whole building (11). Grid-9 elements have been added by the repeating module and are flagged inferred_from_repeating_module., GRID-9 ELEMENTS ADDED 2026-07-25 by the repeating module, after the break-line correction above. S-01 draws 10 column lines because the break hides grid 9; the real building has 11. Three footings (F2/F1/F2 on rows ค/ข/ก, pedestal C1) were added at grid 9 to match every other line, flagged inferred_from_repeating_module at confidence 0.75. The toilet block is an RC structure while the main row building is a steel portal frame; the two buildings use different construction entirely., This sheet gives the SPREAD-footing (แบบฐานแผ่) alternative for all four marks; S-04 (หน้า17) gives the PILE-footing (แบบตอกเข็ม) alternative for the same four marks. Which one is built depends on soil bearing capacity per รายการประกอบแบบ 4.1/4.2 on S-01. The two sets are NOT interchangeable data -- sizes and reinforcement differ substantially, e.g. F1 is 0.75x0.75 with 5+5ø12 as a pile cap but 0.90x0.90 with 6+6ø9 as a spread footing., CORRECTION to a note written on หน้า17 (S-04): there, F1 and F3 share a single combined detail drawn as 'F1,F3'. On THIS sheet they are drawn separately and are NOT the same size -- F1 is 0.90x0.90 with 6+6ø9 and F3 is 1.00x1.00 with 6+6ø12. So the marks coincide only in the pile-footing option, not in general. Do not merge F1 and F3 across footing types., Pedestal marks are printed here as 'C-1' and 'C-2' with a hyphen, while the footing plans on S-01 and the section callouts on S-04 write them as 'C1' and 'C2' without one. element_id is kept exactly as printed on each sheet per spec §8; a downstream join on element_id must normalise the hyphen. Both refer to the same two pedestals -- C-1 250x250 4ø15 and C-2 200x200 4ø12, each stated to run ฐานราก-หลังคา (footing to roof)., Column reinforcement is recorded under main_bar.all_faces rather than top/bottom: spec §6's top/bottom split describes a beam's tension/compression faces and does not apply to a square column section with 4 corner bars. This is a deliberate deviation, flagged here rather than forced into the beam shape., B5's additional 2ø19 top bars over the intermediate support are recorded in additional_bars with their printed 1.15 m length, NOT merged into main_bar.top, because the elevation shows them stopping short rather than running the full length -- per spec §7 the leader and the drawn extent decide, and here the bar is visibly curtailed.
